source_evidence: Exact player 'yes' authorizes Fenar establishing a safe rope descent and party following into the newly visible cavern. D338~06:49–06:58. Fenar inspects the existing ore hoist rope in lower gallery: new DM-adjudicated mundane physical detail, sound approximately45ft length, sufficient for30ft drop and secure anchors, no new personal equipment assumed. She temporarily detaches rope from unused basket, secures it around sound rock on shelf away from fractured lip, and climbs down the rough near wall using existing Bestial Soul CLIMB40 adaptation (no ability check for difficult climb surfaces), checks lower landing and steadies rope. V and Cirren follow one at a time with rope and substantial footholds, not an uncertain free climb; no check, fall or damage. Rope stays deployed and recoverable, site-owned/unclaimed, no expenditure or ownership transfer. Mara stays with intact coach/four horses on road. New natural cavern geometry DM-established as exploration: roughly65ft long,40ft wide, ceiling rising to shelf height; near dry gravel/rock bank and narrow underground stream crossing far end, enters low rock opening and leaves through another low water channel, no verified safe dry continuation. Visible sediment/debris above current waterline on lower walls suggests water sometimes rises well above its current level; no active surge or certain prediction. The same metallic-gray seam is visibly exposed in near wall over a larger unworked stretch and appears again along opposite bank where rock is exposed; whether continuous through intervening rock, assay, grade, volume, ownership and commercial viability remain unverified. No fresh mining cuts, camp, built structure or hostile creature observed on illuminated landing and adjoining bank; no blanket cavern clearance, no exact reason for Derro sealing proven. Cirren's Light still active until~07:10; Detect Magic already expired. No crossing stream, new roll, HP or limited resource change, claim of loot, rest or supply consumption. V may inspect cavern/vein, examine watermarks, take samples, or return.
